raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary Three small fixes in `multimodal_gen/runtime/models/sensenova_u1/neo_unify`: 1. **Think mode dropped reasoning from attention.** `condition_prefix_lengths` was computed from the original prompt, before `_generate_think` appended the think tokens and `\n\n` to the KV cache. `prepare_flash_kv_cache` then used the short length, so `_flash_or_sdpa` took the per-sample compact path and kept only `k[:orig_len]` plus image tokens (same loss on NPU-FIA via `_copy_right_aligned_prefix_bnsd`). The length is now recomputed from the cache after `_generate_think`. 2. **Transformers 4.x import break.** `model_input_compat` was only defined in the `try`, so the `except ImportError` path left it undefined. It now falls back to a no-op decorator. 3. **NameError when `vision_model` is passed.** `vision_model_mot_gen` was only created in the `else` branch; it is now built unconditionally. ## Tests - New regression test for (1): stubs the model and asserts the `prefix_lengths` given to `prepare_flash_kv_cache` equal the full cache length in think mode. Fails on base, passes with the fix. - `test_sensenova_u1.py` and `test_sensenova_u1_backbone.py` on CPU (Modal): 78 passed, 1 skipped. - No import test for (2): CI pins transformers 5.19.0, so the 4.x path is not exercised. ## Not included `_apply_time_schedule` forces `"standard"`; fixing it changes outputs, so it is left for a separate issue. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :no_entry_sign: [Run #41794622489](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41794622489) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #41794622631](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41794622631) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :white_check_mark: [Run #41794622341](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41794622341) > [!TIP] > Base CI only covers the core cases, and its workload may not exercise your change. +class _StopAfterPrepare(Exception):

+def test_sensenova_u1_think_mode_prefix_lengths_cover_think_tokens(monkeypatch):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.sensenova_u1.neo_unify import (
+        modeling_neo_chat,
+    )
+
+    prompt_len, total_len = 5, 12  # 7 think/appended tokens added to the cache
+
+    class _Layer:
+        keys = values = torch.zeros(1, 1, total_len, 2)
+
+    class _Cache:
+        layers = [_Layer()]
+
+        def get_seq_length(self):
+            return total_len
+
+    class _Stub:
+        patch_size = 16
+        downsample_ratio = 0.5
+        concat_time_token_num = 0
+        config = SimpleNamespace(t_eps=0.02)
+        device = torch.device("cpu")
+        _build_t2i_image_indexes = NEOChatModel._build_t2i_image_indexes
+
+        def _notify_layer_offload_phase(self, *_):
+            pass
+
+        def _build_t2i_query(self, *_, **__):
+            return "q"
+
+        def _build_t2i_text_inputs(self, *_):
+            return (
+                torch.zeros(1, prompt_len, dtype=torch.long),
+                torch.zeros(1, 3, prompt_len, dtype=torch.long),
+                None,
+                None,
+                torch.tensor([prompt_len]),
+            )
+
+        def _think_prefix_forward(self, **_):
+            return SimpleNamespace(
+                past_key_values=_Cache(), logits=torch.zeros(1, 1, 2)
+            )
+
+        def _generate_think(self, _tok, _out, cache, t_idx, _img):
+            return cache, t_idx + 7, "thought"
+
+    captured = {}
+
+    def _spy(cache, current_len, batch_size, prefix_lengths):
+        captured["prefix_lengths"] = prefix_lengths
+        raise _StopAfterPrepare
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(modeling_neo_chat, "prepare_flash_kv_cache", _spy)
+    with pytest.raises(_StopAfterPrepare):
+        NEOChatModel.t2i_generate(
+            _Stub(), None, "a cat", image_size=(32, 32), think_mode=True
+        )
+    assert captured["prefix_lengths"].tolist() == [total_len]
